road.name: Bacon Creek Road (Mt. Baker-Snoqualmie NF)
road.driveNote: Leaves WA-20 about 6 miles northeast of Marblemount near Bacon Creek (milepost ~112) and dead-ends at roughly 850 ft elevation. A 2018 rockslide near the 4.7-mile mark narrowed the road to high-clearance vehicles only (repair status unconfirmed) — check current Mt. Baker-Snoqualmie NF conditions before the drive.

access.fees: No park entrance fee; backcountry/wilderness camping permit required for all overnight stays ($10 per person plus a $6 permit fee from mid-May to early October; no charge the rest of the year).
access.notes: 60% of sites are reservable in advance via Recreation.gov (2026 lottery Mar 2–13); the remaining 40% are walk-up, obtained in person the day before at the Wilderness Information Center in Marblemount.
access.rules: Group size capped at 6 in off-trail cross-country zones (which includes most Picket Range approaches; 12 in on-trail corridors). Bear canisters required in some zones — free loaners at permit offices.
access.permit: Wilderness/backcountry permit required year-round for overnight stays anywhere on the approach or in the range; obtained at the Wilderness Information Center in Marblemount (walk-up or Recreation.gov reservation).
access.closures: Placing new fixed anchors/bolts is prohibited under the park's wilderness climbing moratorium (clean-climbing techniques required); SR 20 access road is closed seasonally each winter. Luna Fire closure (as of mid-September 2026): the Big Beaver Trail is closed from Big Beaver Stock Camp to Stillwell Camp, and Luna Camp, Beaver Pass Camp (with its stock and group camps) and 39 Mile Camp (with 39 Mile Stock) are closed; cross-country zone access from closed trails is prohibited. The closure moves - check current park fire closures before a trip.
access.landManager: National Park Service — North Cascades National Park, within the Stephen Mather Wilderness
access.land_manager: National Park Service — North Cascades National Park (Stephen Mather Wilderness)

overnight_permit.what: North Cascades NP backcountry permit (cross-country zone), fee per person, not free
overnight_permit.where: Reserve on Recreation.gov, or get a walk-up permit in person at the Marblemount Wilderness Information Center. Hannegan-side permits can also be picked up at the Glacier Public Service Center on its limited summer days.
